recordedDeviations: DanTerm requires canonical padded Base64 where windows-terminal also accepts omitted padding.
DanTerm supports xterm X10 and SGR mouse encodings, not UTF-8 1005 or alternate-scroll 1007.
DanTerm treats raw C1 bytes as UTF-8 input and does not expose parser states or dispatch callbacks.

cases.name: DecodeFuzz
cases.rationale: Native OSC 52 tests cover canonical padded decoding, malformed inputs, strict UTF-8, exact decoded bounds, deterministic fuzz recovery, and chunk splits; omitted padding is deliberately rejected.

cases.name: DecodeUTF8
cases.rationale: osc52-unicode.json pins the two previously uncovered valid non-ASCII UTF-8 payloads through the public clipboard-write channel.

cases.name: DefaultModeTests

cases.name: Utf8ModeTests

cases.name: SgrModeTests

cases.name: ScrollWheelTests

cases.name: AlternateScrollModeTests

cases.name: TestEscapeImmediatePath

cases.name: TestEscapeThenC0Path

cases.name: TestGroundPrint

cases.name: TestCsiEntry

cases.name: TestC1CsiEntry

cases.name: TestCsiImmediate

cases.name: TestCsiParam

cases.name: TestCsiMaxParamCount

cases.name: TestCsiSubParam

cases.name: TestCsiMaxSubParamCount

cases.name: TestLeadingZeroCsiSubParam
cases.rationale: CSIParserTests and TerminalStyleTests cover numeric normalization inside colon-separated SGR groups.

cases.name: TestCsiIgnore
cases.rationale: CSIParserTests covers invalid parameter/intermediate transitions dropping dispatch without poisoning later CSI.

cases.name: TestC1Osc
cases.rationale: Raw C1 OSC is deliberately unsupported in DanTerm's UTF-8 input mode.

cases.name: TestOscStringSimple

cases.name: TestLongOscString
cases.rationale: DanTerm's native tests cover its stronger 2 MiB encoded-string and per-value retention bounds.

cases.name: NormalTestOscParam
cases.rationale: Native semantic-event and query tests exercise ordinary OSC selector parsing through public outcomes.

cases.name: TestLeadingZeroOscParam

cases.name: TestLongOscParam
cases.rationale: Native OSC parsing bounds selector accumulation and recovers to later valid input without exposing parser storage.

cases.name: TestOscStringInvalidTermination
cases.rationale: TerminalOSC52Tests and TerminalInputStreamTests cover invalid ESC termination canceling OSC and restarting escape recognition.

cases.name: TestDcsEntry

cases.name: TestC1DcsEntry
cases.rationale: Raw C1 DCS is deliberately unsupported in DanTerm's UTF-8 input mode.

cases.name: TestDcsImmediate
cases.rationale: CSIParserTests and TerminalInputStreamTests cover bounded DCS collection and recovery without exposing private states.

cases.name: TestDcsIgnore
cases.rationale: TerminalInputStreamTests covers unsupported DCS absorption and later printable recovery.

cases.name: TestDcsParam
cases.rationale: CSIParserTests covers DCS parameter overflow, discard, and recovery through public actions.

cases.name: TestDcsIntermediateAndPassThrough

cases.name: TestDcsLongStringPassThrough

cases.name: TestDcsInvalidTermination

cases.rationale: TerminalInputStreamTests covers bounded SOS, PM, and APC absorption plus 7-bit ST recovery.

cases.name: TestC1StringTerminator

cases.name: TestCsiCursorMovementWithoutValues
cases.rationale: CSICursorMovementTests covers omitted and zero cursor parameters defaulting to one.

cases.name: TestCsiCursorPosition
cases.rationale: CSICursorMovementTests covers CUP and HVP positioning through public cursor geometry.

cases.name: TestCsiCursorPositionWithOnlyRow
cases.rationale: CSICursorMovementTests covers partial CUP parameters and default columns.

cases.name: TestCursorSaveLoad
cases.rationale: TerminalSavedCursorTests covers ANSI and DEC aliases plus full saved-state round trips.

cases.name: TestAnsiMode

cases.name: TestPrivateModes
cases.rationale: TerminalModeTests and TerminalMouseModeTests cover every implemented private mode through public state.

cases.name: TestMultipleModes
cases.rationale: TerminalModeTests covers left-to-right multi-parameter mode application and inert unknown modes.

cases.name: TestMultipleErase
cases.rationale: CSIEraseTests covers supported erase operations in sequence through public cells.

cases.name: TestSetGraphicsRendition
cases.rationale: TerminalStyleTests covers supported SGR attributes, colors, empty parameters, malformed recovery, and chunk splits.

cases.name: TestDeviceStatusReport
cases.rationale: TerminalQueryTests covers supported status and cursor reports and explicitly pins unsupported forms as no-ops.

cases.name: TestDeviceAttributes
cases.rationale: TerminalQueryTests covers primary DA defaults, exact replies, and malformed forms.

cases.name: TestSecondaryDeviceAttributes
cases.rationale: DA2 remains deliberately unsupported in TerminalCore.

cases.name: TestTertiaryDeviceAttributes
cases.rationale: Tertiary device attributes are not part of TerminalCore's advertised query contract.

cases.name: TestRequestTerminalParameters
cases.rationale: DECREQTPARM is not part of TerminalCore's advertised query contract.

cases.name: TestStrings
cases.rationale: TerminalTests and fixture replay cover multiple sequences, intervening text, chunk splits, and mixed feed boundaries.

cases.name: TestLineFeed
cases.rationale: TerminalTests and scroll-region fixtures cover IND, NEL, LF, VT, and FF through public geometry and history.

cases.name: TestControlCharacters
cases.rationale: TerminalTests and semantic-event tests cover BEL, BS, CR, and HT public effects.

cases.name: TestTabClear
cases.rationale: TerminalTabStopTests covers valid and invalid TBC forms through tab-stop behavior.

cases.name: TestVt52Sequences
cases.rationale: DanTerm does not emulate VT52: the parser holds no VT52 state and no mode reaches it.

cases.name: TestIdentifyDeviceReport
cases.rationale: The VT52/ANSI parser-mode split is unsupported; primary ANSI DA is covered natively.

cases.name: TestOscSetDefaultForeground
cases.rationale: TerminalCore reports injected OSC 10 defaults but does not let terminal output mutate theme defaults.

cases.name: TestOscSetDefaultBackground
cases.rationale: TerminalCore reports injected OSC 11 defaults but does not let terminal output mutate theme defaults.

cases.name: TestOscSetColorTableEntry
cases.rationale: OSC 4 palette mutation is not part of TerminalCore's semantic color contract.

cases.name: TestOscGetColorTableEntry
cases.rationale: OSC 4 palette queries are not part of TerminalCore's query contract.

cases.name: TestOscXtermResourceReport
cases.rationale: TerminalQueryTests covers supported OSC 10 and 11 queries, ordering, exact replies, and invalid forms.

cases.name: TestOscXtermResourceReset
cases.rationale: OSC 110-119 resource reset is not part of TerminalCore's fixed default-color contract.

cases.name: TestOscColorTableReset
cases.rationale: OSC 104 palette reset is not part of TerminalCore's semantic color contract.

cases.name: TestOscSetWindowTitle
cases.rationale: TerminalSemanticEventTests covers supported OSC 0 and 2 titles, empty values, UTF-8, bounds, ordering, and chunking; OSC 1 and 21 remain unsupported.

cases.name: TestSetClipboard
cases.rationale: osc52-unicode.json adopts the previously uncovered multilingual and emoji UTF-8 payloads; native tests supersede its ASCII and malformed cases.

cases.name: TestAddHyperlink
cases.rationale: TerminalHyperlinkTests covers OSC 8 open/close, IDs, unknown parameters, semicolons, URI validation, bounds, and chunking.

cases.name: TestC1ParserMode
cases.rationale: DanTerm has no raw-C1 parser mode and treats ground-state C1 bytes according to its UTF-8 contract.

cases.name: CursorMovementTest
cases.rationale: CSICursorMovementTests.relativeMovement and .lineMovement pin CUU/CUD/CUF/CUB/CNL/CPL defaults, aliases, and clamping through public cursor geometry.

cases.name: CursorPositionTest
cases.rationale: CSICursorMovementTests.twoAxisPositioning pins CUP one-based origin, home, and out-of-range clamping.

cases.name: CursorSingleDimensionMoveTest
cases.rationale: CSICursorMovementTests.axisPositioning pins CHA and VPA defaults and clamping on both axes.

cases.name: CursorSaveRestoreTest
cases.rationale: TerminalSavedCursorTests.restoreBeforeSaveUsesDefaults and .escapeSaveRestoreRoundTrip pin restore-without-save returning home with a reset pen.

cases.name: CursorHideShowTest
cases.rationale: TerminalPresentationModeTests.defaultsAndControlMapping pins DECTCEM driving presentation.isCursorVisible from both starting states.

cases.name: GraphicsBaseTests
cases.rationale: TerminalStyleTests.reset pins both CSI m and CSI 0 m resetting the pen.

cases.name: GraphicsSingleTests
cases.rationale: TerminalStyleTests.attributes and .semanticPaletteColors pin every attribute DanTerm implements. SGR 53/55 overline has no TerminalStyle field and no applySimpleSGR case.

cases.name: GraphicsSingleWithSubParamTests
cases.rationale: TerminalStyleTests.underlineVariants, .extendedColors, and .underlineColors pin the 4:3, 38:5:n, 48:5:n, and 58:5:n colon forms.

cases.name: GraphicsPushPopTests
cases.rationale: DanTerm does not implement XTPUSHSGR or XTPOPSGR: CSI intermediate 0x23 has no case and falls through to no dispatch.

cases.name: GraphicsPersistBrightnessTests
cases.rationale: The libvterm state-pen fixture and TerminalCellStyleTests pin that intensity and indexed color are independent. Mutating SGR 90-97 to set bold, and SGR 30-37 to clear it, both fail the suite.

cases.name: DeviceStatus_OperatingStatusTests
cases.rationale: TerminalQueryTests.primaryQueries pins CSI 5 n answering ESC [ 0 n byte for byte.

cases.name: DeviceStatus_CursorPositionReportTests
cases.rationale: TerminalQueryTests.primaryQueries and .originRelativeCursorReport pin CPR bytes and DECOM-relative rows.

cases.name: DeviceStatus_ExtendedCursorPositionReportTests
cases.rationale: DanTerm has a single page with no page memory. DECXCPR carries no page field and DECPPA does not exist.

cases.name: DeviceStatus_MacroSpaceReportTest
cases.rationale: DanTerm implements no macros: DSR answers only parameters 5 and 6, and there is no DECDMAC handler.

cases.name: DeviceStatus_MemoryChecksumReportTest
cases.rationale: DanTerm does not implement DECCKSR memory checksum reporting.

cases.name: DeviceStatus_PrivateStatusTests
cases.rationale: DanTerm answers DSR for parameters 5 and 6 only. Printer, UDK, keyboard, locator, data integrity, and multi-session reports are unimplemented.

cases.name: DeviceAttributesTests
cases.rationale: TerminalQueryTests.primaryQueries pins the DA1 reply and .unsupportedQueriesAreSilent pins CSI 1 c as a no-op.

cases.name: SecondaryDeviceAttributesTests
cases.rationale: DA2 is deliberately unsupported: CSI > c is pinned silent by TerminalQueryTests.unsupportedQueriesAreSilent.

cases.name: TertiaryDeviceAttributesTests
cases.rationale: DanTerm does not implement DA3: CSI = c is pinned silent.

cases.name: RequestDisplayedExtentTests
cases.rationale: DanTerm does not implement DECRQDE. DanTerm has a single page with no page memory.

cases.name: RequestTerminalParametersTests
cases.rationale: DanTerm does not implement DECREQTPARM: the CSI final switch has no case for 0x78.

cases.name: RequestSettingsTests
cases.rationale: TerminalDECRQSSTests round-trips every setting DanTerm reports and pins the invalid reply for the rest.

cases.name: RequestStandardModeTests
cases.rationale: TerminalQueryTests.modeQueries pins DECRQM for ANSI modes 4 and 20 with exact CSI Ps ; Pv $ y bytes in both states.

cases.name: RequestPrivateModeTests
cases.rationale: TerminalQueryTests.modeQueries pins every DEC private mode DanTerm implements, plus unknown modes answering 0.

cases.name: RequestPermanentModeTests
cases.rationale: TerminalQueryTests.modeQueries pins mode 2027 answering 3, permanently set, through set, reset, and initial query.

cases.name: RequestChecksumReportTests
cases.rationale: DanTerm does not implement DECRQCRA: CSI intermediate 0x2A has no case.

cases.name: ColorTableReportTests
cases.rationale: DanTerm has no mutable palette, so DECCTR has nothing to report.

cases.name: Osc4ColorPaletteReportTests
cases.rationale: DanTerm has no OSC 4 palette table, so there is nothing to report.

cases.name: XtermColorResourceReportTests
cases.rationale: TerminalQueryTests.defaultColorQueries and .defaultColorQueryOrderingAndRecovery pin OSC 10 and 11 replies and OSC 12 silence.

cases.name: TabulationStopReportTests
cases.rationale: DanTerm does not implement DECTABSR. DCS dispatch routes only DECRQSS, so this report never comes back.

cases.name: CursorInformationReportTests
cases.rationale: DanTerm does not implement DECCIR. DCS dispatch routes only DECRQSS, so this report never comes back.

cases.name: CursorKeysModeTest
cases.rationale: TerminalModeTests.inputModeProjection pins DECCKM set and reset on the public inputModes projection.

cases.name: KeypadModeTest
cases.rationale: TerminalModeTests.inputModeProjection pins ESC = and ESC > application-keypad toggling.

cases.name: AnsiModeTest
cases.rationale: DanTerm has no VT52 parser mode: the mode catalog has no DECANM entry and the parser runs one ANSI state machine.

cases.name: AllowBlinkingTest
cases.rationale: TerminalPresentationModeTests.cursorBlinkModeAndStyleComposition pins DEC mode 12 on presentation.isCursorBlinking.

cases.name: ScrollMarginsTest
cases.rationale: TerminalScrollRegionTests.decstbmNormalizationAndArity pins both-values, top-only, bottom-only, omitted, inverted, and out-of-bounds DECSTBM.

cases.name: LineFeedTest
cases.rationale: TerminalModeTests.lineFeedNewLineMode and TerminalScrollRegionTests.escapeIndexControls pin LNM-dependent LF and the IND/NEL column rule.

cases.name: SetConsoleTitleTest
cases.rationale: TerminalSemanticEventTests.titleAndCwd and .cwdTitleFallback pin non-empty and empty titles through the semantic-event drain.

cases.name: TestMouseModes
cases.rationale: TerminalMouseModeTests.trackingModeExclusivity and .encodingModeIsolation pin modes 1000, 1002, 1003, and 1006.

cases.name: Xterm256ColorTest
cases.rationale: TerminalStyleTests.extendedColors and .extendedColorForms pin indexed color through 38;5 and 48;5.

cases.name: XtermExtendedColorDefaultParameterTest
cases.rationale: TerminalStyleTests pins the pen unchanged when an extended-color selector carries no operand. Mutating the selector to substitute 0 fails the suite.

cases.name: XtermExtendedSubParameterColorTest
cases.rationale: The same TerminalStyleTests coverage reaches the colon grammar: extendedColor handles both grammars through one function.

cases.name: SetColorTableValue
cases.rationale: DanTerm does not implement OSC 4 palette mutation.

cases.name: SoftFontSizeDetection
cases.rationale: DanTerm does not implement DECDLD soft fonts. DCS dispatch routes only DECRQSS, so this report never comes back.

cases.name: TogglingC1ParserMode
cases.rationale: DanTerm has no C1 parser mode and no DOCS coding-system designation: dispatchEscape has no percent-intermediate branch.

cases.name: AssignUserPreferenceCharsets
cases.rationale: DanTerm does not implement DECAUPSS. DCS dispatch routes only DECRQSS, so this report never comes back.

cases.name: RequestUserPreferenceCharsets
cases.rationale: DanTerm does not implement DECRQUPSS. DCS dispatch routes only DECRQSS, so this report never comes back.

cases.name: MacroDefinitions
cases.rationale: DanTerm does not implement DECDMAC macros. DCS dispatch routes only DECRQSS, so this report never comes back.

cases.name: MacroInvokes
cases.rationale: DanTerm does not implement DECINVM: the CSI final switch has no star-z case.

cases.name: WindowManipulationTypeTests
cases.rationale: DanTerm does not implement XTWINOPS: the CSI final switch has no case for 0x74.

cases.name: MenuCompletionsTests
cases.rationale: DanTerm does not implement the OSC 633 Completions action.

cases.name: PageMovementTests
cases.rationale: DanTerm has a single page with no page memory. PPA, PPR, PPB, NP, PP, and mode 64 do not exist.

cases.name: SendC1ControlTest
cases.rationale: DanTerm does not implement S7C1T or S8C1T and always replies in 7-bit form.

cases.name: C0Test
cases.rationale: The case asserts Win32 console record fields rather than the bytes a terminal sends. It maps C0 bytes back to vkey, scan code, and control-key state.

cases.name: AlphanumericTest
cases.rationale: The case asserts Win32 console record fields rather than the bytes a terminal sends. It maps printable bytes through the console keyboard layout.

cases.name: RoundTripTest
cases.rationale: The case is disabled upstream and drives HandleKey from synthesized console records.

cases.name: NonAsciiTest
cases.rationale: The case asserts Win32 console record fields rather than the bytes a terminal sends. It asserts one UTF-16 unit becoming a key-down and key-up record pair.

cases.name: CursorPositioningTest
cases.rationale: The case asserts the console host capturing a CPR reply that arrives on the input channel. DanTerm has no such capture.

cases.name: CSICursorBackTabTest
cases.rationale: The case asserts Win32 console record fields rather than the bytes a terminal sends. DanTerm's forward direction is pinned by TerminalKeyEncodingTests.legacyTextMatrix.

cases.name: EnhancedKeysTest
cases.rationale: The case asserts the ENHANCED_KEY console flag. DanTerm's forward bytes are pinned by TerminalKeyEncodingTests.completeLegacySpecialKeyMatrix.

cases.name: SS3CursorKeyTest
cases.rationale: The case asserts Win32 console record fields rather than the bytes a terminal sends. DanTerm's forward bytes are pinned by TerminalKeyEncodingTests.applicationCursorModeMatchesXterm256ColorTerminfo.

cases.name: AltBackspaceTest
cases.rationale: The case asserts Win32 console record fields rather than the bytes a terminal sends. DanTerm's forward bytes are pinned by TerminalKeyEncodingTests.completeLegacyControlKeyMatrix.

cases.name: AltCtrlDTest
cases.rationale: The case asserts Win32 console record fields rather than the bytes a terminal sends. It asserts Alt and Ctrl console flags on a decoded record.

cases.name: AltIntermediateTest
cases.rationale: The encoder half is DanTerm behavior, and the libvterm state-input fixture pins the Meta ESC prefix on a printable character. Mutating the prefix away fails the suite.

cases.name: AltBackspaceEnterTest
cases.rationale: The case asserts a private parser state alongside Win32 records.

cases.name: ChunkedSequence
cases.rationale: The case asserts a private parser state of the input state machine.

cases.name: SGRMouseTest_ButtonClick
cases.rationale: The case decodes SGR reports into console mouse records. DanTerm only encodes, and TerminalMouseEncodingTests pins that direction.

cases.name: SGRMouseTest_Modifiers
cases.rationale: The case asserts decoded control-key state bits on console mouse records.

cases.name: SGRMouseTest_Movement
cases.rationale: The case asserts accumulated console button-state masks and the MOUSE_MOVED flag.

cases.name: SGRMouseTest_Scroll
cases.rationale: The case asserts MOUSE_WHEELED and MOUSE_HWHEELED console flags on decoded records.

cases.name: SGRMouseTest_DoubleClick
cases.rationale: The case asserts a host double-click timer synthesizing the DOUBLE_CLICK console flag.

cases.name: SGRMouseTest_Hover
cases.rationale: The case asserts button-released motion decoding into a console motion record.

cases.name: CtrlAltZCtrlAltXTest
cases.rationale: The case asserts a console-host escape-execute parser rule producing Win32 records.

cases.name: TestSs3Entry
cases.rationale: The case asserts private SS3 parser states. DanTerm has no path that parses key sequences.

cases.name: TestSs3Immediate
cases.rationale: The case asserts private SS3 state transitions.

cases.name: TestSs3Param
cases.rationale: The case asserts private SS3 parameter-state transitions.

cases.name: TestWin32InputParsing
cases.rationale: The case calls a private generator and asserts win32-input-mode record fields.

cases.name: TestWin32InputOptionals
cases.rationale: The case asserts default values for omitted win32-input-mode parameters.

cases.name: KeyPressTests
cases.rationale: A 130-row table. TerminalKeyEncodingTests adopts the disambiguate rows DanTerm implements, including F1/F2/F4 leaving the SS3 form and a Shift-only text key staying plain text. Rows using kitty flags 2, 4, 8, or 16 need capabilities DanTerm masks off.

cases.name: KeyRepeatEvents
cases.rationale: DanTerm does not implement kitty flag 2, report event types, so it emits no repeat or release events.

cases.name: KeyRepeatWithModifiers
cases.rationale: Repeat events need kitty flag 2, which DanTerm masks off.

cases.name: KeyRepeatResetOnDifferentKey
cases.rationale: Per-key repeat tracking needs kitty flag 2, which DanTerm masks off.

cases.name: TerminalInputTests
cases.rationale: The case asserts Win32 console record fields rather than the bytes a terminal sends. Its encoding residue is covered by TerminalKeyEncodingTests.completeLegacySpecialKeyMatrix and .completeLegacyControlKeyMatrix.

cases.name: TestFocusEvents
cases.rationale: TerminalFocusReportingTests pins mode 1004 CSI I and CSI O, the silent-when-disabled rule, retention, and chunk invariance.

cases.name: TerminalInputModifierKeyTests
cases.rationale: TerminalKeyEncodingTests.completeLegacySpecialKeyMatrix pins the modifier matrix, and the libvterm state-input fixture pins Alt plus a printable character.

cases.name: TerminalInputNullKeyTests
cases.rationale: TerminalKeyEncodingTests adopts Ctrl+@ emitting NUL, which shares no coverage with Ctrl+Space despite sharing a switch case.

cases.name: DifferentModifiersTest
cases.rationale: TerminalKeyEncodingTests adopts Ctrl+? emitting DEL. The Ctrl+/ rows are dropped: DanTerm returns the literal character there, which research doc 36 records as a defect.

cases.name: CtrlNumTest
cases.rationale: DanTerm maps no digit to a control byte: a digit with Control returns the digit's own UTF-8. Research doc 36 records this as a defect.

cases.name: BackarrowKeyModeTest
cases.rationale: DanTerm has no DECBKM backarrow-key mode. Its fixed backspace behavior equals the mode-disabled half and is pinned by completeLegacyControlKeyMatrix.

cases.name: AutoRepeatModeTest
cases.rationale: DanTerm has no DECARM auto-repeat mode: encodeTerminalKey is stateless and draws no key-down or key-up distinction.

cases.name: SendC1ControlTest
cases.rationale: DanTerm has no 8-bit C1 key-output mode: CSI and SS3 emitters write only the 7-bit ESC forms.

cases.name: TwoStateMachinesDoNotInterfereWithEachOther
cases.rationale: TerminalInputStreamTests.replayAndCopyIsolation and .pendingStateParticipatesInEquality pin copy independence and per-instance pending state on a value type.

cases.name: PassThroughUnhandled
cases.rationale: The case asserts the flush-to-terminal callback topology. DanTerm exposes no pass-through; the behavioral residue is pinned by TerminalModeTests.modeDispatchNormalizationAndSideState.

cases.name: RunStorageBeforeEscape
cases.rationale: TerminalInputStreamTests.streamingCursorConsumesTheChunk pins run accumulation and its flush at the escape boundary as token identity plus index advance.

cases.name: BulkTextPrint
cases.rationale: TerminalInputStreamTests.streamingCursorConsumesTheChunk and TerminalASCIIRunTests pin bulk text arriving as one contiguous run.

cases.name: PassThroughUnhandledSplitAcrossWrites
cases.rationale: The case asserts pass-through accumulation across writes. The split-sequence residue is pinned by TerminalInputStreamTests.chunkBoundaryInvariance at every 2- and 3-way split.

cases.name: DcsDataStringsReceivedByHandler
cases.rationale: TerminalInputStreamTests adopts CAN and SUB aborting a DCS data string, restated as public stream actions. The handler and the data string itself stay out of scope.

cases.name: VtParameterSubspanTest
cases.rationale: The case asserts a private parameter-view type's API. DanTerm's parameters are a fixed 24-slot inline array with no subspan view.

cases.name: TestRoundtripLegacy
cases.rationale: The case round-trips a Win32 legacy attribute word. DanTerm stores colors as TerminalColor cases and has no legacy word.

cases.name: TestRoundtripMetaBits
cases.rationale: The case reads a private member and pins Win32 console meta bits. DanTerm carries underline shape and reverse as named fields and has no grid-line attributes.

cases.name: TestRoundtripExhaustive
cases.rationale: An exhaustive storage-layout round trip of the legacy attribute word, which no DanTerm surface encodes.

cases.name: TestTextAttributeColorGetters
cases.rationale: RenderColorResolutionTests.reverseDimAndHiddenPipeline pins that reverse swaps resolved colors while stored colors stay put, and that dim halves the drawn foreground.

cases.name: TestReverseDefaultColors
cases.rationale: RenderColorResolutionTests.reverseDimAndHiddenPipeline pins a default pen under reverse resolving to the theme pair swapped, which is upstream's answer.

cases.name: TestRoundtripDefaultColors
cases.rationale: The case pins a mapping between a legacy console default index and the semantic default. DanTerm has no legacy index alias.

cases.name: TestIntenseAsBright
cases.rationale: RenderColorResolutionTests.rgbAndBoldColorIndependence pins that bold never brightens an indexed color. DanTerm has no bold-is-bright toggle, matching the SGR 1 definition in ctlseqs.

cases.name: TestDefaultColor
cases.rationale: RenderColorResolutionTests.defaultsAndANSIColors pins an unstyled cell resolving to the theme default pair per slot.

cases.name: TestDarkIndexColor
cases.rationale: RenderColorResolutionTests.defaultsAndANSIColors pins indices 0 through 7 resolving to the dark palette entry in both slots.

cases.name: TestBrightIndexColor
cases.rationale: RenderColorResolutionTests.defaultsAndANSIColors pins indices 8 through 15 resolving to the bright palette entry.

cases.name: TestRgbColor
cases.rationale: RenderColorResolutionTests.rgbAndBoldColorIndependence pins an RGB color passing through untouched by palette or bold policy.

cases.name: TestChangeColor
cases.rationale: TerminalStyleTests.extendedColors, .semanticPaletteColors, and .underlineColors pin last-write-wins across indexed, RGB, and default for all three color kinds.

cases.name: No reflow required
cases.rationale: TerminalResizeTests.widthWalkConservesFullHistory and .cellAnchorsFollowReflowedCells pin narrowing below unused columns trimming a hard row's padding.

cases.name: SBCS, cursor remains in buffer, no circling, no original wrap
cases.rationale: TerminalResizeTests.widthShrinkPreservesTrailingBlanksAndRoundTrips and the libvterm reflow-shell-prompt fixture pin a full row splitting and rejoining while the next hard line stays separate.

cases.name: SBCS, cursor remains in buffer, no circling, with original wrap
cases.rationale: TerminalResizeTests.widthWalkConservesFullHistory and .boundaryAnchorFollowsReflowBoundary pin an already-wrapped line refolding at each width with the cursor following its cell.

cases.name: SBCS line padded with spaces (to wrap)
cases.rationale: TerminalResizeTests.widthWalkConservesFullHistory, the resize fuzz walk, pins printed spaces on a continuing row as content. Dropping them fails the suite.

cases.name: DBCS, cursor remains in buffer, no circling, with original wrap
cases.rationale: TerminalResizeTests and TerminalLogicalLineFoldTests pin the spacer head at a width boundary. Both letting a wide cluster straddle the last column and deleting the spacer write fail the suite.

cases.name: SBCS, cursor remains in buffer, with circling, no original wrap
cases.rationale: The case asserts that rows pushed above the viewport are destroyed, which follows from upstream building its buffer with zero scrollback. DanTerm has no discard path: displaced rows enter history and return when the width grows.

cases.name: SBCS, cursor off rightmost char in non-wrapped line
cases.rationale: TerminalResizeTests.trailingPaddingAnchorPreservesDistance pins a cursor one column past the last character keeping that distance across a refold.

cases.name: SBCS, cursor off rightmost char in wrapped line, which is then pushed off bottom
cases.rationale: TerminalScrollbackBudgetTests and TerminalSavedCursorTests pin the trailing-padding anchor across a viewport overflow. Dropping its row offset fails the suite.

cases.name: SBCS, cursor off in space to far right of text (end of buffer content)
cases.rationale: The case asserts upstream's forced-wrap padding, created only so a later widening restores the cursor column. DanTerm clamps a padding cursor to the right margin and has no forced-wrap provenance.

cases.name: SBCS, cursor off in space to far right of text (middle of buffer content)
cases.rationale: The same forced-wrap padding claim, compounded by the destroyed-row assumption DanTerm's history model does not share.

cases.name: SBCS, cursor off in space to far right of text (end of buffer content), aggressive shrink
cases.rationale: The case asserts multi-row forced-wrap padding created to preserve cursor distance. DanTerm never pads rows for the cursor; the minimum-width shrink itself is pinned by the resize fuzz walk.

cases.name: SBCS, cursor off in space to far right of text (end of buffer content), fully wrapped, aggressive shrink
cases.rationale: The expected output is the shape of upstream's cursor walk over a zero-scrollback circular buffer. DanTerm retains the content and shows the tail of the refolded stream.

cases.name: SBCS, cursor off in space to far right of text (middle of buffer content), fully wrapped, aggressive shrink
cases.rationale: The assertion depends on rows circling out of a scrollback-free buffer, which DanTerm does not do.

cases.name: SBCS, cursor off in space to far right of text (middle of buffer content), partially wrapped, aggressive shrink
cases.rationale: The expected wrap flags belong to blank rows upstream synthesized for the cursor.

cases.name: SBCS, cursor at end of buffer; otherwise, same as previous test
cases.rationale: The case asserts upstream's cursor-walk algorithm directly, by its own comment.

cases.name: TestClampToShortMax
cases.rationale: A Win32 SHORT clamp helper, not terminal behavior.

cases.name: TestGuidToString
cases.rationale: COM GUID formatting, not terminal behavior.

cases.name: TestSplitString
cases.rationale: A generic string splitter, not terminal behavior.

cases.name: TestFilterStringForPaste
cases.rationale: TerminalPastePolicyTests.sanitizationAndLineEndings and .emptyPaste pin line-ending normalization, tab retention, control stripping, and a neutralized embedded bracketed-paste terminator.

cases.name: TestStringToUint
cases.rationale: A generic numeric parser, not terminal behavior.

cases.name: TestColorFromXTermColor
cases.rationale: TerminalCore parses no xterm color spec: there is no reader for rgb:, hash-prefixed hex, or color names.

cases.name: TestMangleWSLPaths
cases.rationale: WSL path rewriting on Windows, not terminal behavior.

cases.name: TestTrimTrailingWhitespace
cases.rationale: DanTerm's paste path performs no trailing-whitespace trimming: sanitized text is bracketed and sent as is.

cases.name: TestDontTrimTrailingWhitespace
cases.rationale: The same absent capability, asserted from the other side.

cases.name: TestEvaluateStartingDirectory
cases.rationale: Windows profile starting-directory resolution, not terminal behavior.

cases.name: GraphemeBreakTest
cases.rationale: GraphemeBreakTests.officialCorpusMatches replays the whole official UAX #29 corpus at Unicode 17.0.0. Upstream's table is 16.0.0 and omits GB3, GB9c, GB11, and GB12/13, which DanTerm implements.

cases.name: BasicGraphemes
cases.rationale: GraphemeBreakTests.officialCorpusMatches and TerminalGraphemeTests pin stacked combining marks segmenting into one unit of width 1.

cases.name: ChunkedText
cases.rationale: TerminalTests chunk-split invariance replays each fixture at every 1- and 2-cut split, which pins a fully qualified emoji cluster surviving scalars split across feeds. Forgetting a VS16 upgrade at a chunk boundary fails the suite.

cases.name: AmbiguousWidthPolicy
cases.rationale: DanTerm has no ambiguous-width setting: width comes from East Asian Wide and Fullwidth only, so Ambiguous is always one column.

cases.name: TestV5UuidU8String
cases.rationale: UUID version 5 generation, not terminal behavior.

cases.name: TestV5UuidU16String
cases.rationale: UUID version 5 generation, not terminal behavior.

cases.name: Unicode
cases.rationale: TerminalSearchTests.foldingAndUnicodeExactness pins exact cell ranges for ASCII, astral, and double-width text. The UTF-16 surrogate handling this case exercises is an ICU concern; DanTerm indexes scalars and cells.
